hypothesis: A text label of an announcement (guidance, event confirmation, tone), read as an ordered value, ranks announcements in the same order as their 20-session market-adjusted outcome within each sign of the announcement-day abnormal return, and the machine label agrees with the Owner's golden label often enough. Each label is its own lineage per market with one look. A pass is recorded for the sentiment-cluster import path only; no status changes.
market_rule: each market is counted and tested on its own announcements and golden labels; a lineage and its plan are per market
counter: the number of distinct items with at least one golden answer 'labelled', counted from the golden table before any outcome is read; the look needs the count to reach label_golden_min (500)
below_floor: INCONCLUSIVE: no look is taken and no outcome is read; the plan stays frozen and the one look waits for the night the count reaches the floor
label_value: ordered value of the newest accepted machine label of the announcement: guidance down -1, same 0, up +1 (none left out); event confirmation contradicted -1, confirmed +1 (unclear left out); tone negative -1, neutral 0, positive +1
sample: announcements of the archive that carry a machine label of that kind and whose 20-session horizon has fully elapsed on the night of the look, with both prices known
ar_stratum: the sign of the announcement session's close-to-close return minus the benchmark index return; zero is left out; two strata, positive and negative
outcome: market-adjusted close-to-close return from the close of the announcement session to the close of the twentieth session after it, minus the benchmark index return over the same sessions
stratum_floor_note: a stratum with fewer than 30 announcements is left out; with no stratum left the result is INCONCLUSIVE and no look is taken
statistic: the mean over the strata kept of the Spearman rank correlation of the label value and the outcome
interval: one-sided 90 % lower bound: the 0.10 quantile of 2000 stationary block-bootstrap replicates of the statistic, resampling announcement sessions with expected block 20 sessions, the ranks recomputed in every replicate, seeded per lineage
agreement: per label, the one-sided 90 % Wilson lower bound of the share of golden items whose machine label equals the Owner's newest labelled answer (an item without a machine label counts as a disagreement), at least 0.70
pass_rule: PASS when the lower bound of the statistic is above zero and the agreement bound reaches 0.70; NULL when the statistic is computed and either fails; INCONCLUSIVE and spent when the statistic cannot be computed (an undefined bootstrap)
late_labels_look: the family look of the announcement-calibration plan (lineage ann_labels) that waited for label coverage is taken by this evaluation on the first night the archive count is at its floor and at least 70 % of the holdout announcements carry a label, under that plan's own rules
consequence: a PASS is recorded; entry into the sentiment cluster goes through the passport import, which is a later reviewed step
